school.school_name: アルスコンピュータ専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve a public disclosure page where current-year R8 PDFs are syllabi/course plans, while the latest target confirmation-form PDF is still R7.
steps: Use the Saitama official-index disclosure URL registered for the school.
Inspect the R8_*_0420.pdf links and verify they are 年間授業計画/シラバス PDFs, not target confirmation forms.
Follow the R7確認申請書類 様式第2号 link.
Classify the result as publication_lag_latest_public because the latest target-form PDF is explicitly R7/FY2025 while no R8 target-form PDF is public.

reusable_rules: Do not accept R8/2026 filename evidence unless the PDF or link also has target-form markers.
Treat current-year course-plan or syllabus PDFs as non-target even when the URL contains R8.
Keep the latest old-year target confirmation form as publication-lag evidence when no target-year form is discoverable.
anti_patterns: Do not infer target-form status from R8 in the URL alone.
Do not let a current-year syllabus hide an older target-form PDF on the same disclosure page.
Do not classify 様式第2号別紙 or course-plan PDFs as the main target confirmation form.

evidence.notes: Windows v339 bounded Saitama replay marks school_id 758 as publication_lag. Manual pdftotext inspection found the R8_IT/R8_GB PDFs contain 年間授業計画/シラバス text and no target-form markers, while the R7 様式第2号 PDF is the latest target-form candidate.
